historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission gave conceptual approval to the Grove Memorial group, an offshoot of Friends of the Urban Forest, to renovate de Laveaga Dell as a memorial to those who have died of AIDS, with new landscaping, drainage and the rebuilding of the rocky watercourse at the dell's west end.
De Laveaga Dell was laid out with new loam, clay and trees, and rockwork was built in the dell.

The old Deer Glen, its deer moved to a new enclosure south of the drive, was made into De Laveaga Dell: a footpath under overhanging oaks, a boulder-lined creek bed running to a small pond, rock ledges planted with ferns and succulents, and six large iris beds.
